entities.summary: Anselm Joseph McLaurin was an American politician. A member of the Democratic Party, he served as the 34th governor of Mississippi from 1896 to 1900. Prior to being governor, he served as United States Senator from Mississippi from 1894 until 1895 and then again from 1901 until his death in 1909.
